name: Text My Lights
author: Nick Spica (thespica93)
description: Viewers text a name that appears on your light display - via Twilio SMS or Google Voice. Runs as a background layer on the Pi so it can play alongside your main show; use sequences (.fseq) for Waiting and Name Display content - video and playlists are not supported at this time. Includes message queueing, profanity filtering, name whitelist/blocklist, auto-responses, per-phone rate limiting, and duplicate detection.

privacy.summary: Names people text to your show are relayed through your Twilio or Google Voice account and shown on your lights; sender phone numbers and messages are stored on this device to run the display.

sends.what: Reads inbound SMS (sender number + text) from your Twilio account; sends optional reply texts
sends.why: Receive the names people text and optionally reply

sends.what: Reads Google Voice SMS-to-email (sender + text) from your Gmail; can send optional replies
sends.why: Receive texted names when Google Voice is the source

collects.what: Sender phone numbers and texted names/messages
Blocked and approved phone numbers / names
Your Twilio auth token and Gmail app password

systemChanges.what: Adds an /etc/sudoers.d rule allowing a validated root helper to give the overlay model's shared-memory file to the fpp user/group (group-writable, not world) for pixel rendering

privacy.other: Credentials are stored in an owner-only (0600) file and are removed on uninstall. The plugin also installs FPP scheduler command scripts (TextMyLightsStart/Stop). No data is sent anywhere except your own Twilio/Google accounts.
